author: WeRcharlieKIRK
quote: This game is extremely boring, and a pathetic display of greed and overwhelming stupidity from gaming studios. It takes forever to get into the actual open world segment of the game because the game is more concerned with teaching you how to paint and set up drywall while displaying boring main "Characters" not that you're missing out on much since the game is essentially gtav but with a bunch of mods. Seriously embarrassing. This game will almost certainly bring the end of gaming as we know it. it will popularize the most anti-consumer practices we haven't seen yet. No disc, overpriced game, garbage loot crate and I'm assuming the microtransactions for online will somehow be even more ridiculous than red dead and fives combined and that's really saying something considering those games are literally just pay to win. The microtransactions will get worse and worse the games themselves will get more and more expensive and at a certain point we will probably not even by buying games but will instead just be paying a subscription to play them temporally since we will own nothing and not even be happy. Then we will look back to see where it started, and we will see that this garbage is what is responsible along with the gun and ball idiots who bought it. If you care for your rights as a consumer do not buy this game and if you already have refund it.
